question: Should this issue become a Linux-first companion roadmap using Windows Hub as the Windows baseline, and which Linux architecture and security and packaging contract should OpenClaw sponsor?
rationale: The capability fits VISION.md, but current main and the closed candidate PRs do not establish a maintainable Linux architecture, remaining Windows scope, or an accepted security and distribution model.

options.title: Linux-first native GTK
options.body: Use Windows Hub as the supported Windows baseline and sponsor a staged GTK-native Linux companion under an explicit security, packaging, and parity plan.

options.title: Keep two platform tracks
options.body: Retain native Windows parity and Linux as separate deliverables under this umbrella with distinct owners and acceptance milestones.

options.title: Pause implementation intake
options.body: Keep the roadmap open but defer new implementation PRs until a desktop owner and architecture review are complete.

recommendation.title: Linux-first native GTK
recommendation.body: Use Windows Hub as the supported Windows baseline and sponsor a staged GTK-native Linux companion under an explicit security, packaging, and parity plan.

likelyOwner.reason: He established the issue's product direction, platform preference, and priority calibration and has the strongest companion-app history.
